topics.title: Watcher-driven cycle release
topics.recommendation_summary: Use watcher signal thresholds with timeout fallback to reduce non-actionable cycles.
tradeoffs: Lower idle cycles may increase scheduler complexity.
Timeout tuning must avoid false positive worker-stall resets.

open_questions: Should max-work mode be enabled per project profile or globally?
